# CyDoc build dependency

- Repository: https://github.com/MrMybal/CyDoc
- Commit: `6ddf9a582defb2f11fbb3f992afef6f98dcadc93`
- Package version: `0.1.0` (the repository version has not changed).
- Local archive: `cydoc-0.1.0-6ddf9a5.tgz`.
- Distribution method documented by CyDoc: authenticated Git checkout, `npm ci`, `npm run build`, `npm pack --ignore-scripts`.
- The archive contains CyDoc's MIT license; builds copy it to `Documentation/DocData/CyDoc-LICENSE.txt`.
- The archive was built from the above unmodified checkout. Public API: `cydoc`, `cydoc/api-import`, CLI build/check and stock exported viewer.

Only image and gallery modules are exported. The application does not alter generated reader files or expose its implementation source tree.
